verdicts.title: Computing sandpile configurations using integer linear programming
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: It is well known that recurrent sandpile configurations can be characterized as the optimal solution of certain optimization problems. In this article, we present two new integer linear programming models, one that computes recurrent configurations and other that computes the order of the configuration. Finally, by using duality of linear programming, we are able to compute the identity configuration for the cone of a regular graph.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract describes ILP models for computing recurrent sandpile configurations and identity configurations, which shares the sandpile vocabulary but does not address the largest invariant factor of the Laplacian nor Tseitin/resolution proof complexity.
